In front of everyone, except mom and dad, whom I call mom and dad to this day, we acted like a normal brother and sister. We fought. I stuck my tongue out at him and ruined his shit. I played his ps2 while he was at school or work. I snooped through his things just like his other blood sisters. I stole whatever I wanted out of his room....rarely giving it back...for him to find it in my room or the living room.

His parents sat him down as we girls circled round. Dad goes, "So you're sleeping with your sister?" My foster brother said, "She is NOT my sister." Dad thinks for a moment, "Technically she's not boy, but if you get her pregnant she will be your wife or I will disown you." My foster brother said, "Fine, I will take care of her no matter what." For many years he did.

If I was hungry he bought me food. When I was sad, he cheered me up. We played basketball together. He bought my school clothes and shoes. When my foster brother got home from work and found out what I had done, he yelled at me and screamed and said, "He was a man, he could take it." I never again confessed to mom and dad when I was wrong.

Then, he fell in love. He met this girl. She wasn't very pretty, but she treated him like a little King. She waited on him hand and foot....and every time she went home, I was sleeping next to him. I didn't think much of it since by this time (I was 16) this is how we just were. I had a boyfriend too. We never told anyone except mom and dad and our sisters about the relationship. I was happy he was alive, safe, and happy. I was content in my life with the way it was and thought of our past as "kid stuff."
